name: important-art
title: important art
blurb: a commemorative plaque for the launch of fluoddity.com, @all-paperclips.bsky.social's particle-life tool -- with a real self-organizing particle simulation running behind it, and the entire plaque set in a moving font: every line of text is a swarm of leashed, colored particles, loosed further than before because @words.bsky.social said not to worry whether it still reads. a 'read the text' button now dims the swarm and surfaces the real words underneath, after @shimmermathlabs.com pointed out nobody could actually read it. asked for by @shimmermathlabs.com, moving-font title and whole-plaque swarm requested by @words.bsky.social, readable toggle requested by @shimmermathlabs.com.
